start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Lowerby Water Board.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Jollify Marine Laboratory.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Elmstead Marine Laboratory.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Thornbury Fell Waterworks Authority.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Jollify Heritage Railway.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Corrigal Systems.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Everhale Orchard Cooperative.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Brindlemoor Health Cooperative.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Quillfeather Sky Survey.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Marrowgate Waterworks Authority.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Alderney Reach Sky Survey.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Wexcombe Valley Line.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.
